newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile shares end stable with focus on Q4 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Chile shares end stable with focus on Q4 earnings.

text.p: Chile shares on Monday trimmed early losses to close slightly softer, as Wall Street's surge propelled the bolsa forward late in the day, traders said.

The bourse is seen holding steady at the opening with investors waiting for fourth-quarter earnings, which Chilean companies are required to release this week, said Guillermo Tagle, head of research at Santander Investments.
"Although earnings have been already incorporated in stock prices, some shares could slip as the results are not expected to be good," he said.
The index ended off 0.05 percent at 115.83 points.
